title: Typical Path Problem
constraintsSummary: Time limit: 2 sec; Memory limit: 1024 MiB; Constraints: 3 \leq N \leq 2\times 10^5; N-1\leq M\leq\min\left(\frac{N(N-1)}{2},2\times 10^5\right); 1\leq A,B,C\leq N; A, B, and C are all distinct.; 1\leq U_i<V_i\leq N; The pairs (U_i,V_i) are all distinct.; All input values are integers.
